newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - IPALCO EPS view up.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - IPALCO EPS view up.

text.p: -- Everen Securities Inc said Friday it raised its above-consensus earnings estimates for IPALCO Enterprises Inc by $0.01 a share to $2.27 for fiscal 1997 and to $2.47 for fiscal 1998.
-- It also confirmed the outperform rating on IPALCO.
-- On Thursday, IPALCO said it will spend $401.2 million to repurchase all of the approximately 12.5 million shares tendered at or below $32 a share through its Dutch auction tender offer.
-- Everen said its earlier forecasts were based on 12.0 million shares being repurchased.
-- Everen said it believes consensus earnings estimates of $2.19 for fiscal 1997 and $2.42 for fiscal 1998 are likely to be subject to some upward revisions.
